name: Blackreach Station

conflict_flags.detail: status is 'active' while the source states the station was destroyed. The status was set by the 2026-03-19 bulk promotion on a record with no description or notes, so it is unlikely to be a considered assertion.
conflict_flags.why_unchanged: The location status vocabulary has no destroyed value — 46 location records use 'active' and 3 use 'alias_forward_only'. Introducing one is a vocabulary decision across the whole field, not a per-record reconciliation, and FABRIC C2 governs character living status rather than places. Routed alongside selene-ark-status-vocab.

promotion_note: Single-source mission site; named, typed, active.

p1_downgrade.invariant: P1 — the map authority table is the source of truth for placement; an entity position status must not exceed its map row.
p1_downgrade.basis: No row exists in the Location Authority Table, so no map authority supports a canonical placement claim.
p1_downgrade.scope_note: This downgrades the PLACEMENT CLAIM only. The entity itself remains CANON; its attributes are unaffected. Placement re-promotes when the map-authority / Reconciliation Workflow §4.5 process supplies evidence (precedent: loc_vel_surak was downgraded 2026-07-21, then legitimately re-promoted when its map row was promoted).
p1_downgrade.detected_by: aurora-canon-reconciler FABRIC P1 check (added 2026-08-09); previously invisible because tools/fabric_invariants_check.py is Velar-domain-scoped.

character.embedded_activity: Hosted a rogue AI research facility embedded within the station.

fate.operation: Neutralised during Operation Silent Dagger — a covert strike to neutralise the rogue AI research facility, eliminate leadership, and extract intelligence.
fate.corroboration: The record already carries a silent_dagger tag, so the link was known; the outcome was not recorded. org_union_intelligence_bureau records gaining access to rogue faction communication networks after an operation that crippled pirate presence in the sector and permanently shut down illegal AI research — the same event, from the intelligence side.

prose_ledger_triage.excluded: A "used for high-deniability intelligence operations" line sits above the Blackreach bullet in a list and may describe the preceding entry; not attributed here.

resolved_referents.basis: Fully documented in committed canon as LEDGER-MISSIONS-0001 in the marshals/sentinel ledger — named actors with roles, assets, tactics, opposition, outcome and a casualty — and referenced by org_sentinel_high_command and five operator capsules. It had no entity record, which is a reconstruction loss rather than an absence of evidence.
